name: Manganic-Quoin
description: Bare rock from pole to pole, shaded in grays, ox-blood reds, and pale magnesium white. The regolith records four billion years of bombardment, scarred through by magnetic pole anomalies near the terminator.

The silence has texture, close to audible. Old survey teams left notes about hearing their own heartbeats as knocking. Carpet-flora blooms all at once after each rare rain, turning whole basins scarlet overnight.
The oldest impact basin predates the system's estimated age by a comfortable margin. The survey bureau has quietly stopped publishing the numbers.
Whoever controls platinum controls the approach lanes. Three factions have done the arithmetic, and only two of them are being subtle about it.
